title: ClockEE Vercel Production Deployment, Remote Tracker & Interactive Task Control

tasks.task: Activate Interactive Prioritization & Execution Mode. List all upcoming deployment tasks to the user, allow the user to physically reorder or set priorities, and wait for the user to manually trigger individual tasks rather than executing on blind auto-pilot. Also establish live broadcasting of tracker_state.json to Supabase mesh_tracker_state table so tracker.html is accessible from anywhere.

Implement Vercel Serverless Python Adapter (api/index.py) connected to Supabase cloud PostgreSQL. Verify that database is connected properly and bypasses local SQLite on Vercel. Implement Google Auth and GitHub OAuth token validation and session caching. Wire /api/tracker to stream live mesh state and provide requirements.txt.

Configure production vercel.json rewriting /api/(.*) to /api/index.py and /tracker to /tracker.html. Set security headers, CORS, and immutable cache-control for CBT question banks. Configure .vercelignore to exclude local SQLite databases (clockee.db, clockee_auth.db), temp videos, and pipeline internals.

Client-Side Production Environment Resolution, Google Auth Integration & Remote Tracker Hydration. Support Google Login via Supabase OAuth with redirect back to https://clockee.vercel.app. Extract access token from URL hash, store in session, and authenticate API requests. Update tracker.html to fetch from /api/tracker so the user can view live agent activities from anywhere. Verify offline queue auto-syncs on reconnect.

Mobile Mission Control Cockpit & Tactical Auth Polish. Optimize tracker.html for mobile smartphone viewports so the user can easily monitor agent activities from anywhere on the go. Polish Google Login buttons and Auth modal to seamlessly fit ClockEE's tactical cyberpunk aesthetic. Add live edge connection status pill to navigation.

2-Pass Live Browser Deployment Audit. Pass 1: Open live https://clockee.vercel.app in browser; test Google OAuth login, Supabase database queries, CBT exams, and remote tracker. Pass 2: Simulate offline disconnection and verify auto-sync. If any defects occur, compile detailed report and hand off to BUG FIXES.

Surgical Production Remediation. Receive defect report from Simulation, surgically patch any issues in routing, Google Auth redirects, CORS, or database queries, and hand back to Simulation for second verification pass.
